title: Four decades of dengue epidemics in Brazil: data and code for a scoping review of serotype succession, severity and evidence gaps
description:
Data set, search logs, codebook and Python scripts that reproduce the figures, tables and results of a scoping review on dengue epidemics in Brazil (1981-2026).

Contents: charting table of the 286 included studies (103 from PubMed/MEDLINE, SciELO, ScienceDirect and SciSpace, and 183 from the full screening of 459 LILACS records); coded variables (federative unit, region, spatial scale, study design, epidemic period, source of serotype information); serotype-year evidence matrix (106 studies, 495 records); search and screening logs; PRISMA flow diagram and checklist; Figures 1-3 and Tables 1-2.
